English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #fakenews Do NGO officials spread AIDs under the guise of offering free blood tests? False A voice message circulating on WhatsApp regarding blood tests done by NGO Officials free of charge has caught the attention of many as FactSeeker received numerous requests to investigate the matter. by Anonymous | May 27, 2024 The audio tape which appears to be sent from a Non-governmental organization (NGO) claimed that the individuals who come to each house to do the blood tests spread AIDs instead. While the audio appalled many, a majority had circulated the voice message as requested. FactSeeker examined mainstream media for reports of the said audio message, but came to an understanding that the incident was not reported. An official from the Ministry of Health confirmed that an incident involving officials of NGOs had not been reported. Police Spokesman DIG Nihal Thalduwa too confirmed that the Police had not received any complaints regarding the said matter. He warned the public to beware of such messages that are created with the intent of startling the general public. Accordingly, FactSeeker confirms that the voice message circulating on WhatsApp claiming that NGO officials spread AIDs under the guise of offering free blood tests is false. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
